module: Declares the "topLeft" app container (top-left corner of the interface) with ui_appContainers. The UI trigger is setTopLeftAppVisibility. Declared apps: messages and tasks (visible by default), scoreboard, driftScores, dragInfo and dragDialControl (hidden by default).
notes: Replaces the old identifier utilityApps (see ui_appContainers.resolveContainerId).

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads: registers the topLeft container via ui_appContainers.registerContainer.
